scope: Single-thread read-only analysis of recorded robot run. No ROS nodes/CAN/hardware commands; no point-cloud arrays read.
time_and_identification_limits: Bag timestamps are recorder callback entry, before its shared write lock. ROS log header is source publish time. cmd_vel, status, tracking_fault have no source header/cycle id; cross-topic callback delay and queue_size=1 drops prevent exact pairing in every case.

Categories below classify evidence within zero-command episodes; 46 freshness-associated episodes must not be asserted as 46 uniquely proven onset causes. Each row includes matching delay and confidence boundary.
4 tracking_fault=true packets all identify /whole_body_mppi as actual callerid. Therefore generic FSM wording excessive trajectory error does not prove a base tracking error.

Cycle_ms is sampled inside reject after stop_base/reference-lock handling. It is not exact solver elapsed. The three no-feasible cycles above95ms do not alone prove elapsed was above95ms when the result-none branch ran.

Source code shows a distinct confirmed defect: result=None raises no_feasible before elapsed/deadline check. This branch can escalate an expired result; the actual solve elapsed is not stored for these real failure cycles.

final_recovery_failure.source_mechanism: GEN_NEW_TRAJ increments new_traj_fail_time_ when planFromGlobalTraj() fails. At>=5 it clears have_target_/have_new_target_/have_local_traj_ and returns WAIT_TARGET. planFromGlobalTraj starts from mm_state_pos_, mm_state_vel_, zero acceleration/jerk; each iteration tries candidate optimization subject to wall-time budget. Optimization success text alone does not imply final kinematic acceptance.
final_recovery_failure.observed_failures: Recovery candidates fail left-wheel omega/alpha checks at relative0.05s; logs include omega -12.441464/-26.604736 and alpha77.940914/67.877407/89.163544. These are candidate constraints, not measured wheel speeds.
final_recovery_failure.boundary: Only failure counters2/5 and3/5 plus terminal give-up were captured; queue_size=1 can omit individual1/5,4/5,5/5 logs. Five-attempt exhaustion is supported by source condition+final log, not by five complete captured attempt transcripts.
